A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
F-actin is a polymer of actin subunits with a bound nucleotide, and that this nucleotide may be replaced by other nucleotides under certain conditions.
the bound ADP (AMP) of F-actins is not a constituent part of the F-actin molecule, but it is a part of the actin-myosin complex and is removed from F-actin by ultrasonics.
